name: better-sqlite3
description: Fastest and simplest synchronous SQLite3 library for Node.js with WAL concurrency and atomic transaction wrappers.
author: Awesome API Skills Team
pitfalls: Awaiting db.prepare().get() or treating better-sqlite3 methods as Promises (all operations are strictly synchronous)
Forgetting db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL') after opening the database, resulting in SQLITE_BUSY lock contention under concurrent reads
Running async functions inside db.transaction() callbacks (transactions throw if callback returns a Promise)
checklist: db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL') and db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON') executed on connection initialization
Prepared statements cached or reused via db.prepare()
Batch writes wrapped inside synchronous db.transaction((items) => { ... })
